title: Add EUR context geometry sources
changes: Represent six separately authenticated context geometry sources, including one reused as both an initial rectangle and a target, in the existing layered resource while preserving original game state and timing.
validation: Wine e144-geometry-wine-170mmiv4 checks the E143 projection, all 48 poisoned source bytes and mixed-width boundaries, plus seven original-helper cases with matching raw and managed states and clocks.
The first test build e144-geometry-build-rr8qummd failed because the test lacked the Bus trait import; the corrected Windows cross-build e144-geometry-build-retry-zt_jqavv passed.
Wine e144-geometry-cli-wine-atuj1ub2 passes production CLI creation, no-write reuse, verification and one-frame startup; 102 other resource files match E143.

Wine e144-ordinary-wine-ewu2vo72 observes all seven source call sites in one no-input continuation; each one-frame interpreter and native-dispatch raw/managed pair matches state and clock with poisoned sources, typed reads and no raw source reads.
limitations: Other scenes and consumers, per-read native attribution, frontend save/load, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurements.
